That channel was strictly stronger than this one and had none of its bounds: adversarial review showed it could waive the retrieval requirement across an entire register, waive this log's own date checks, and admit an ungoverned register. One channel now, with reason, actor, expiry, a per-signature cap, and visibility in the diff.
